Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before the product intro:

- Current priority: reduce inference latency for your customer-facing features and cut token spend per session.
- Primary workloads: short chat completions (~150–300 tokens) plus periodic batch embeddings for search relevance.
- Constraints: data residency in us-west, requirement for audit logs, and a small ops team responsible for deployments.

Next step: schedule a 30-minute product intro (short demo + Q&A) to show relevant performance profiles, routing options, and how Dedicated capacity could fit your SLA needs. Ideally join with the stakeholders you mentioned: Dana (product), Priyanka (SRE), and your procurement lead if available.

Can you pick 2–3 windows (30-min blocks) in the next two weeks that work for the group? To make this easy, here are a couple of suggested windows (all PST):

- Tue Nov 17 — 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Wed Nov 18 — 2:00–2:30 PM PST
- Thu Nov 19 — 8:30–9:00 AM PST

Suggested agenda (30 min):
- 0–12m: quick product walkthrough tailored to your latency/cost constraints
- 12–22m: focused discussion on routing/fallbacks and audit/logging controls
- 22–30m: next steps / mutual action plan items

I attached a one-page discovery summary and a draft mutual action plan to this thread for reference. If you prefer, I can send calendar invites once you confirm a preferred slot.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

—
